newsitem.title: UK: UK Treasury sees improvement in manufacturing.
newsitem.headline: UK Treasury sees improvement in manufacturing.

text.p: The British Treasury said data on Tuesday showed the improvement in the economy has spread to the manufacturing sector.

"The three quarters percent increase in manufacturing output in the third quarter alone shows that the improvement in the economy has spread to manufacturing as well (as other sectors)," a Treasury official said.

The Office for National Statistics (ONS) said industrial production rose 0.5 percent in September and was up 0.3 percent from a year earlier, while manufacturing output rose 0.3 percent in the month and was up 0.2 percent from a year before.
This compared with economists' forecasts that both industrial production and manufacturing output would show 0.5 percent monthly rises.
In the three months through September industrial production was up 0.3 percent and manufacturing output up 0.7 percent, the ONS said.
